RUS_ip_enable_gui = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = RUS
			is_ai = no
			NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_ip_ui_unlocked }
		}
		set_country_flag = RUS_ip_ui_unlocked
		RUS_ip_open_effect = yes
	}
}

RUS_ip_open_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			RUS_ip_available = yes
		}
		RUS_ip_initialize = yes
		set_country_flag = RUS_ip_open
		clr_country_flag = RUS_ip_help_open
		clr_country_flag = RUS_ip_supply_open
		clr_country_flag = RUS_ip_cancel_armed
		RUS_ip_refresh = yes
	}
}

RUS_ip_close_effect = {
	clr_country_flag = RUS_ip_open
	clr_country_flag = RUS_ip_help_open
	clr_country_flag = RUS_ip_supply_open
	clr_country_flag = RUS_ip_cancel_armed
	add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_dirty = 1 }
}

RUS_ip_toggle = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			RUS_ip_available = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = RUS_ip_open
			}
			RUS_ip_close_effect = yes
		}
		else = {
			RUS_ip_open_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

RUS_ip_start = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			RUS_ip_available = yes
			has_country_flag = RUS_ip_open
			NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_ip_started }
		}
		set_country_flag = RUS_ip_started
		set_country_flag = RUS_ip_active
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_days_left = 1800 }
		RUS_ip_refresh_extraction = yes
		RUS_ip_capture_capacity = yes
		RUS_ip_refresh = yes
	}
}

RUS_ip_toggle_help = {
	clr_country_flag = RUS_ip_supply_open
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = RUS_ip_help_open
		}
		clr_country_flag = RUS_ip_help_open
	}
	else = {
		set_country_flag = RUS_ip_help_open
	}
	add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_dirty = 1 }
}

RUS_ip_toggle_supply = {
	clr_country_flag = RUS_ip_help_open
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = RUS_ip_supply_open
		}
		clr_country_flag = RUS_ip_supply_open
	}
	else = {
		set_country_flag = RUS_ip_supply_open
	}
	add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_dirty = 1 }
}

RUS_ip_prioritise = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			RUS_ip_editing = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { RUS_ip_priority = RUS_ip_selected }
			}
			set_variable = { RUS_ip_priority = -1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { RUS_ip_priority = RUS_ip_selected }
		}
		RUS_ip_refresh = yes
	}
}

RUS_ip_refresh_extraction = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = RUS_ip_started
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = RUS_ip_active
				check_variable = { RUS_ip_mining_completed < 15 }
			}
			set_variable = { RUS_ip_resource_penalty = RUS_ip_mining_completed }
			multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_resource_penalty = 0.02 }
			subtract_from_variable = { RUS_ip_resource_penalty = 0.3 }
			clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_resource_penalty min = -0.3 max = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_ip_extraction_bottleneck } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_ip_extraction_bottleneck }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { RUS_ip_resource_penalty = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_ip_extraction_bottleneck }
				}
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_ip_extraction_bottleneck }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_resource_penalty_percent = RUS_ip_resource_penalty }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_resource_penalty_percent = 100 }
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}

RUS_ip_capture_capacity = {
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_capacity_civs = num_of_civilian_factories_available_for_projects }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_capacity_civs = RUS_ip_reserved_civs }
	clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_capacity_civs min = 0 max = 99999 }
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_capacity_steel = resource@steel }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_capacity_steel = RUS_ip_reserved_steel }
	clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_capacity_steel min = 0 max = 99999 }
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_capacity_coal = resource@coal }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_capacity_coal = RUS_ip_reserved_coal }
	clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_capacity_coal min = 0 max = 99999 }
}

RUS_ip_survey = {
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_connected_count = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_energy = energy_ratio }
	clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_energy min = 0 max = 1 }
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_energy_percent = RUS_ip_energy }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_energy_percent = 100 }
	# Sum only owned AND controlled members; population/industry-weighted infrastructure.
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_members = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_pop_k = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_civs = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_mil = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_coal = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_steel = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_grid = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_infra = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_infra_weight = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			owns_state = 213
			controls_state = 213
		}
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_members = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_pop_k = 213.state_population_k }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_civs = 213.industrial_complex_level }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_mil = 213.building_level@arms_factory }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_coal = 213.resource@coal }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_steel = 213.resource@steel }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_grid = 213.building_level@energy_infrastructure }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_survey_weight = 213.industrial_complex_level }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_survey_weight = 213.building_level@arms_factory }
		multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_survey_weight = 100 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_survey_weight = 213.state_population_k }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_survey_weight = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_infra_weight = RUS_ip_survey_weight }
		multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_survey_weight = 213.infrastructure_level }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_infra = RUS_ip_survey_weight }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			owns_state = 722
			controls_state = 722
		}
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_members = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_pop_k = 722.state_population_k }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_civs = 722.industrial_complex_level }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_mil = 722.building_level@arms_factory }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_coal = 722.resource@coal }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_steel = 722.resource@steel }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_grid = 722.building_level@energy_infrastructure }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_survey_weight = 722.industrial_complex_level }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_survey_weight = 722.building_level@arms_factory }
		multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_survey_weight = 100 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_survey_weight = 722.state_population_k }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_survey_weight = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_infra_weight = RUS_ip_survey_weight }
		multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_survey_weight = 722.infrastructure_level }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_infra = RUS_ip_survey_weight }

	set_variable = { RUS_ip_n1_grid = 0 }

				limit = {
					has_country_flag = RUS_ip_active
					RUS_ip_site_35_5 = yes
					check_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_paused = 0 }
					check_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_connected = 1 }
				}
				set_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_status = 5 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							check_variable = { RUS_ip_free_civs < 5 }
						}
					}
					set_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_running = 1 }
					set_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_status = 1 }
					add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_running = 1 }
					subtract_from_variable = { RUS_ip_free_civs = 5 }
					add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_reserved_civs = 5 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_connected = 0 }
					RUS_ip_owned_35 = yes
				}
				set_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_status = 4 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_project = 6 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = RUS_ip_active
					RUS_ip_site_35_6 = yes
					check_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_paused = 0 }
				}
				set_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_status = 5 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							check_variable = { RUS_ip_free_civs < 2 }
						}
					}
					set_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_running = 1 }
					set_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_status = 1 }
					add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_running = 1 }
					subtract_from_variable = { RUS_ip_free_civs = 2 }
					add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_reserved_civs = 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_project = 7 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = RUS_ip_active
					RUS_ip_site_35_7 = yes
					check_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_paused = 0 }
				}
				set_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_status = 5 }
				if = {

						}
					}
					set_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_running = 1 }
					set_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_status = 1 }
					add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_running = 1 }
					subtract_from_variable = { RUS_ip_free_civs = 2 }

RUS_ip_apply_reservations = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { RUS_ip_reserved_civs > 0 }
				check_variable = { RUS_ip_reserved_steel > 0 }
				check_variable = { RUS_ip_reserved_coal > 0 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_ip_construction_commitment } }
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_ip_construction_commitment }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_ip_construction_commitment }
			}
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_ip_construction_commitment }
		}
	}
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}

	set_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_population = RUS_ip_n0_pop_k }

	set_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_workers = 4 }

RUS_ip_budget_daily = {
	add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_budget_day = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				check_variable = { RUS_ip_budget_day < 30 }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_last_budget = RUS_ip_budget_net }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_last_budget = 100 }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_last_support = 25 }
		subtract_from_variable = { RUS_ip_last_support = RUS_ip_last_budget }
		clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_last_support min = 0 max = 99999 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_last_budget = RUS_ip_last_support }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_funds = RUS_ip_last_budget }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_funds_settled = RUS_ip_last_budget }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_budget_net = 0 }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_budget_day = 0 }
	}
}

		divide_variable = { RUS_ip_n34_percent = RUS_ip_n34_required }
		multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_n34_percent = 100 }
		clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_n34_percent min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_speed = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_eta = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_running = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_calc_project = RUS_ip_n35_project }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_calc_development = RUS_ip_n35_development }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_calc_infra = RUS_ip_n35_infra }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_calc_civs = RUS_ip_n35_civs }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_calc_coal = RUS_ip_n35_coal }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_calc_steel = RUS_ip_n35_steel }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_calc_workers = RUS_ip_n35_workers }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_calc_workers_need = RUS_ip_n35_workers_need }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_calc_power = RUS_ip_n35_power }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_calc_power_need = RUS_ip_n35_power_need }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_calc_freight = RUS_ip_n35_freight }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_calc_freight_used = RUS_ip_n35_freight_used }
		RUS_ip_regional_rate = yes
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_speed = RUS_ip_calc_speed }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_bottleneck = RUS_ip_calc_bottleneck }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_worker_ratio = RUS_ip_calc_worker_ratio }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_power_ratio = RUS_ip_calc_power_ratio }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_freight_ratio = RUS_ip_calc_freight_ratio }
		multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_speed = RUS_ip_n35_material_factor }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_material_factor < 1 }
			}
			set_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_bottleneck = 4 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_speed > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_eta = RUS_ip_n35_required }
			subtract_from_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_eta = RUS_ip_n35_work }
			divide_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_eta = RUS_ip_n35_speed }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_speed = 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_status = 6 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_percent = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_required > 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_percent = RUS_ip_n35_work }
		divide_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_percent = RUS_ip_n35_required }
		multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_percent = 100 }
		clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_n35_percent min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
}
